The '''Bes system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Two battles occurred in the system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />

==History==
The Bes system was [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic coordinates]] M-20.<ref name="EAOC" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Nocto]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a resupply operation of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] in this system came under attack from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces during the [[First Battle of Bes]] and shortly afterward a combined Rebel/[[Airam (group)|Airam]] force tried to destroy the ''Rage'' without success in the [[Second Battle of Bes]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Bes system appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''.<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
